label: step4-adjudicate-1
tail:
Step 4 adjudication complete. All three refused edges decided per-edge, and the stage gate is green.

**Edge 1 — batch 2, `chain-conditions-and-semisimple-modules` → `the-field-of-fractions-and-localisation`: applied, moved to the B page.** Backward (53.2 → 108/109) and genuinely consumed, but a reverse sweep of every batch-2 dep against the target's 22 published ids found exactly one consumer, and it is on the B page: `fs-noetherian-rings-have-noetherian-subrings` cites `def-field-of-fractions` and `thm-field-of-fractions-is-a-field-and-the-domain-embeds` — both of which say what it needs (Frac(D) is a field, D embeds). No A-page item uses it, so I struck it from the A page's manifest and declared it on the B page in both manifest and plan. Fifteen published `-examples` pages already carry a prerequisite their A page lacks, one of them this same target.

**Edges 2 and 3 — both batch 7: struck, because the dependencies they would have licensed are themselves illegal.** `validate-plan` check 6 (`b-leaf`) makes any dep on an examples-page item a hard error regardless of `requires`, and in both cases the target's **A** page was already in the closure — so no edge was ever needed, only a repaired citation route:

- `thm-the-covariant-power-set-monad` cited a published example for functoriality of direct image and naturality of `η`. Replaced with the A-homed pieces (`def-functor-…`, `def-natural-transformation`, `prop-sets-and-functions-form-category-set`, `def-image-and-preimage-…`, `def-union-of-a-set-…`); the theorem verifies both inline, as the same page already does natively for the ultrafilter monad.
- `ex-the-ultrafilter-monad-on-a-finite-set` cited three published B-page examples. `lem-ultrafilter-prime` (A page) *is* the finite-partition argument; `fs-every-ultrafilter-principal` is homed on the A page and its refutation builds the free ultrafilter on ℕ from the ultrafilter lemma. I added the in-batch naturality lemma and `def-finite-cardinality`, and put the full route into each item's `strategy` so the authoring Beta can't reach for the illegal citation again.

**Three further defects, not in the refusals file, were red in the same gate before this dispatch** and I fixed them: the identical `b-leaf` defect twice in batch 3 (`ex-biquadratic-extension-has-four-embeddings`, rebuilt via Eisenstein + the tower law; `fs-every-algebraic-extension-is-simple`, rerouted to its own page's `ex-algebraic-closure-of-a-finite-field`), and an *undeclared* backward prerequisite in batch 6 — `cor-cauchy-inequalities` substitutes `2πr` and cites `thm-circle-circumference-diameter-ratio-is-pi`, so `pi-the-equivalent-characterizations` was added to the goursat page's requires.

No forward edges appeared, so nothing is blocked on an owner reading-order decision.

Two engine gaps worth your attention, both recorded in `research/frontier-15-alpha-step4.md`: `splice-plan` refuses only on manifest-declared edges the plan lacks, so batch 6's *missing* declaration was structurally invisible to it; and its drift test compares item **ids only**, so a deps-or-strategy-only manifest change never propagates to an already-spliced page (which is why batch 3's repairs were copied into `plan-spec.json` programmatically, then verified identical on both sides).

Gates: `validate-plan` 0 errors (was 3), `splice-plan --all --dry-run` exit 0 with no refusals, and a simulated post-splice plan with batches 2 and 7 in place is also clean. I did not run the splice, and wrote no defect-ledger rows — step 4 owns no adjudication rows under `CLAUDE.md`, and the reasoning is in the report.
